question: 'The Style Diary of a Bollywood Diva' is the autobiography of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kareena Kapoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The book titled **'The Style Diary of a Bollywood Diva'** is an autobiographical style guide written by the famous Indian actress **Kareena Kapoor Khan**.
 
• It was officially launched in **February 2013** and provides a comprehensive look into her **fashion evolution**, personal life, and beauty secrets.
 
• The book was co-authored by **Rochelle Pinto** and published by **Penguin Books** under the **Shobhaa De Books** imprint.
 
• In this book, **Kareena Kapoor** shares her experiences regarding her famous **"size zero"** phase, her diet plans, and her approach to styling for various occasions, from red carpets to casual outings.
